proved_internal_obligations.meaning: Ordinary components use the ordinary Kirby colour; dotted components use only the normalized tensor-unit cut.
The cycle-level formula descends to the handle-chain H2 class without modular killing.

The case split is source-bound for all eight moves. The two-over-two branch uses proved attach/detach evaluation theorems whose only new trust boundary is the pair of pointwise clean-endpoint interpretation axioms.
Relative to the explicit clean-endpoint interpretation boundary, every admitted elementary move preserves the presentation formula, so finite Kirby movies preserve it.

A clean 2/2 certificate can no longer point at unrelated declared slices. Its attach and detach slices are uniquely tied to the exact canonical trace states at the replacement-window entrance and exit, and the replacement windows are exactly the recorded transport event lists.

The opaque StandardOrientedBandTransport shell, CleanWindow.transport_standard field, and public compatibility parameter were deleted. The two remaining axioms quantify directly over the exact CleanWindow, so no content-free certificate can be mistaken for a proved normal form.
The role-aware two-over-two module now imports CanonicalSourceBoundSlideMovie directly. The old standardSharedFreeWindow axiom is no longer in the new mainline dependency closure.

The remaining endpoint bridge can no longer be supplied as one opaque resolve function or as an untwisted Bärenz-Barrett endpoint. Lean constructs the channel-weighted closed window from the exact common exterior and separately requires only the source and target evaluation identifications. The weighted endpoint equality itself is a theorem derived from the internal character transport. The resolve definition merely reassembles the two remaining geometric fields.

The source and target evaluator terms are tied to one role-aware exterior. The moving and stationary ordinary labels and both oriented two-strand boundary objects are derived from the same structural binding, so the new route no longer borrows the legacy local-boundary decoder.

For every remaining-label block and every moving/stationary simple pair, the target coefficient is proved equal to the exact source coefficient, including both character powers. The outer moving coefficient is computed from the unit/unit complement, moving quantum dimension, orientation, and residual exponent; it is no longer a field of the unresolved endpoint obligation. Lean also proves that the residual moving coefficient times the visible channel coupon reconstructs the exact original coefficient: positive orientation uses (a+b)+(-b)=a, while negative orientation uses (a-b)+b=a.

For the negative endpoint x tensor y, Lean independently sums every simple z and every multiplicity coordinate mu, transports the common character coupon through that internal channel, and proves that the residual moving coupon plus the channel coupon reconstruct the two original handle coupons. This does not reuse the positive endpoint through an unrecorded mirror. Both orientations are also transported through the exact source presentation context selected by the role-aware move.

For both orientations, the internal simple z, fusion projection, character coupon on z, fusion inclusion, and quantum-dimension weight are explicit categorical Diagram syntax. Lean proves that evaluating each visible diagram gives the previously verified channel morphism. These theorems use only standard Lean logic; they do not fill or assume the remaining clean-band transport.

Lean proves term by term that an arbitrary scalar weight on the internal simple fusion channel survives the Bärenz--Barrett braiding and mate movies and remains on the surviving target channel. It then specializes that weight to the actual character scalar eta_z^n and derives n=-b for the positive role-aware endpoint and n=b for the negative endpoint. This is not the still-missing identification of the complete source and target presentation blocks with these stages.

The obsolete stage-3.1.3 untwisted endpoint API was deleted after the role-aware mainline moved to the character-weighted stage-3.1.4 endpoint. Future code cannot silently discharge a twisted slide by reconnecting the old untwisted endpoint theorem.
No second modular invariance proof or modular killing assumption is used by the public modular theorem.
